disclaimer: Curated notes are not medical advice. Safety tiers describe kitchen mechanism, not a guarantee. Always verify with the restaurant before dining. Cross-check Find Me Gluten Free for high-stakes celiac decisions.

places.name: Bolay Fresh Bold Kitchen
places.allergy_safety_note: Build-your-own bowls with a celiac-aware kitchen / dedicated prep protocols. Strong choice for sensitive diners — still confirm the day-of with staff.

places.name: Bolay Fresh Bold Kitchen
places.allergy_safety_note: Same Bolay concept as Pinecrest — celiac-aware kitchen north of the city. Confirm with staff before ordering.

places.name: Dora's Bakery & Bistro
places.allergy_safety_note: Dedicated gluten-free bakery & bistro — the local answer for GF Cuban-style breads/pastries. Not a shared kitchen.

places.name: Almotti Gluten Free Italian Delicacies
places.allergy_safety_note: 100% gluten-free Italian bakery/deli — pasta and baked goods without shared-kitchen wheat risk. Verify current hours before you go.

places.name: Nami Nori
places.allergy_safety_note: Hand-roll sushi treated as a rare celiac-friendly sushi option in Miami. Confirm soy/sauce protocols with staff — do not assume every roll is safe.

places.name: Pizza Fusion
places.allergy_safety_note: Strong GF pizza protocols and allergy-aware menu — NOT a dedicated facility. Residual shared-kitchen risk; better for 'GF options' than hyper-sensitive celiac.

places.name: Burton's Grill & Bar
places.allergy_safety_note: Well-known allergy-trained program (Broward). Shared kitchen — not dedicated. Useful when you need trained staff protocols north of Miami-Dade.

places.name: Versailles Restaurant
places.allergy_safety_note: Iconic Cuban — some plates can work gluten-free, but it is a SHARED kitchen with flour everywhere. Call ahead; higher risk for celiac. Traditional Cuban bread/croquetas are wheat.

places.name: True Food Kitchen
places.address: 3201 Ponce de Leon Blvd, Coral Gables, FL 33134
places.allergy_safety_note: Allergy-aware national brand with GF-marked plates and vegetarian options. Shared kitchen — confirm cross-contact practices for your need.

places.name: Flower Child
places.allergy_safety_note: Build bowls with GF grains/proteins marked on menu. Shared prep — ask about fryer and sauce cross-contact if highly sensitive.

places.name: Coyo Taco
places.allergy_safety_note: Corn tortillas help many GF diners, but shared kitchen / fryers. Verify sauces and prep — not a dedicated facility.

places.name: Panther Coffee
places.allergy_safety_note: Coffee shop with plant-milk options. Not an allergy kitchen — ask about milk steamer cross-contact if dairy-allergic.

places.name: Lovegrove Organics
places.address: Miami Design District area — verify address
places.allergy_safety_note: Plant-forward / juice bar style spot — good vegetarian/dairy-free direction, but nut cross-contact is common. Ask before ordering if nut-allergic.

places.name: Sukha
places.allergy_safety_note: Plant-based menu helps dairy/vegetarian needs. Still verify gluten and nut handling — vegan ≠ dedicated allergy kitchen.
